clarifications.monthly_attribution: Attribute each realized account return to its actual exit UTC calendar month. All calendar months in the evaluation interval remain in the denominator; zero-return months are not positive.
clarifications.half_attribution: Assign each trade to the half containing its entry timestamp.
clarifications.profit_factor: Sum positive account-currency PnL divided by the absolute sum of negative account-currency PnL.
clarifications.maximum_drawdown: Initial registered screen uses the one-global-slot realized-equity curve at trade exits. Any candidate passing the development economic gate must receive bar-level marked-to-liquidation NAV drawdown before selection opens.
clarifications.minimum_traded_symbols: Count symbols with at least one realized trade.
clarifications.state_exit_precedence: Protective stop is evaluated first within every bar. A completed-bar state exit is then scheduled for the next exact open. The maximum-lifetime exit is last.
clarifications.missing_bar_policy: Reject a trade if any signal-to-exit price bar is missing or if the next exact entry/exit open is absent. Do not shorten a trade to the last available bar.
clarifications.candidate_ids: Hash the complete family, feature and execution parameter tuple; identical signal paths under different maximum-hold or stop parameters remain distinct candidates.
